title: Solution Specification Schema
description: Minimal structure for mapping specifications to problems, maintaining traceability to requirements and domain knowledge

specifications.description: Array of specifications that map to problems in the problem tree

specification.description: A specification that addresses one or more problems and satisfies requirements

specification-name.description: Name or title of the specification

specification-description.description: Description of what the specification defines and how it addresses problems

problem-references.description: Array of problem IDs from the problem tree that this specification addresses

requirements-satisfied.description: Array of requirement IDs (from set R) satisfied by this specification

domain-knowledge-used.description: Array of domain knowledge IDs (from set K) used in this specification

consistency-validation.description: Status of consistency checks for this specification

with-domain-knowledge.description: Whether specification is consistent with domain knowledge (K)

with-requirements.description: Whether specification satisfies requirements (R) when combined with K

environment-constraint-check.description: Whether specification does not constrain the environment

unshared-components-check.description: Whether specification does not use unshared actions or state components

future-reference-check.description: Whether specification does not refer to the future
